# SYNLAB

> > Europe's leading medical laboratory diagnostics provider offering comprehensive testing solutions for patients, healthcare providers, and organizations across 30+ countries.

SYNLAB is a global diagnostic services company headquartered in Munich, Germany, specializing in laboratory diagnostics, genetic testing, and rare disease detection. The platform serves individual patients, healthcare professionals, and organizations with advanced diagnostic solutions and quality-assured clinical testing.
